title: IELTS Reading Pilot — Illustrative Practice
description: Unofficial original pilot. Contains three short passages and representative formats; not a full IELTS test.

reading.instructions: Read each original passage and answer its linked questions.

passages.title: A cooler street
passages.content: In the town of Merrow, residents planted rows of small trees along a paved shopping street. Sensors showed that shaded pavement was cooler at midday than nearby exposed pavement. Shop owners also noticed that people paused longer near benches placed beneath the trees. The council plans to compare energy use in nearby buildings over the next summer before deciding whether to expand the project.

passages.title: The shared workshop
passages.content: A former railway storehouse now houses a community workshop. Members book tools online, while volunteers teach safe use during weekly sessions. The workshop accepts donated equipment only after inspection; items that cannot be repaired are sent to a recycling centre. Membership is open to adults and teenagers accompanied by an adult.

passages.title: Mapping the marsh
passages.content: A university team mapped seasonal pools in the Daran marsh. Their first survey took place after unusually heavy rain, so the team repeated measurements in a drier month. The second map showed fewer pools, but it did not prove that the marsh was shrinking: water levels vary naturally, and the researchers had not yet collected a full year's data. They recommend annual surveys using the same landmarks.
